preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setMaxTxAmount(0) to set the maximum transaction amount to zero. This will cause all transfers from non-owner addresses to revert due to the require(amount <= _maxTxAmount) check in _transfer(), while the owner can still transfer freely. The owner retains exclusive transfer rights while all other users are blocked from transferring tokens.
